text:
arjun: quick FYI — EU2 GPU warm-up is stalled, nodes reporting KMS Decrypt 403 after the "audit-e11" VPCE policy landed at ~08:45.
mira: logs?
arjun: grep from keystore sidecar on gpu-eu2-ctl-9:
```
2026-03-25T08:47:12Z ERROR keystore: AccessDeniedException: User is not authorized to perform kms:Decrypt on arn:aws:kms:eu-west-2:111:key/f1e2d3c4
node: gpu-eu2-ctl-9
```
arjun: The VPCE policy added an explicit Deny for principals without the audit:owner tag. Looks like privatelink assume-role calls are losing that tag and the Deny shadows the Allow.
kevin: Ops alert spiked: ops-bot: alert keystore.kms.403 x 73 last 10m — https://ops/redwood/alerts/keystore-eu2-403
audit-team: we pushed the Deny to close a silent egress channel to central SIEM — wanted to force regional mirrors. We didn't anticipate privatelink role tag behavior.
mira: mitigation options? We have a customer rollout this afternoon; need GPUs online.
oncall-sre: Two immediate choices: 1) revert VPCE policy (fast, high blast radius on audit), 2) add emergency KMS grant scoped to keystore role + patch VPCE to add a narrow Allow for keystore Decrypt (preferred). Recommend #2 with strict TTL and SourceVpc condition.
kevin: prefer #2. Approve emergency grant for 3h TTL. Make it granular to Decrypt only and log to CloudTrail.
arjun: proposed commands (canary flow):
```
aws kms create-grant --key-id alias/keystore-eu2 --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::111:role/keystore-privatelink --operations Decrypt --name "eu2-temp-onboard"
# then patch vpce policy file: add single Allow for arn:aws:iam::111:role/keystore-privatelink with kms:Decrypt and condition SourceVpc==vpc-0a1b2c3d
aws ec2 modify-vpc-endpoint --vpc-endpoint-id vpce-0a1b2c3d --policy-document file://vpce-keystore-allow.json
```
audit-team: add a CloudTrail tag and reference the change id in compliance stream. We'll require the grant creation to be short-lived and auditable.
oncall-sre: canary plan: apply grant, restart keystore on gpu-eu2-ctl-9, verify decrypt -> kubelet secrets pulled -> node Ready. If >20% nodes fail after 10m, rollback.
arjun: creating grant now.
arjun: grant created id g-0x1a2b3c4d. Testing canary node.
arjun: canary decrypted and joined, kubelet Ready. :tada:
kevin: patching vpce policy to include the Allow and SourceVpc condition; TTL set to 3h. Rolling canary to eu2-az1.
audit-team: follow-ups: - update privatelink CI to simulate assume-role and tag propagation - add policy snippet to audit PR showing explicit keystore exception - cost assessment for regional SIEM mirrors (~€130/day estimate)
oncall-sre: monitoring started 09:05. Current recovery: 14/18 previously pending nodes recovered after grant + policy patch. Watching delivery metrics for audit shipper; will rollback if we see missing logs or if node recovery stalls.
arjun: thanks. I'll draft a 1-paragraph postmortem and attach the vpce snippet + CloudTrail link.
kevin: adding a privatelink policy unit test to catch Deny shadowing.
ops-bot: alert updated: keystore.kms.403 reduced; requires manual close — https://ops/redwood/alerts/keystore-eu2-403
